feature: A clip brought onto the timeline shows its sound
summary: A recording you add from the Library or drag in from the Finder now draws the shape of its sound on the Audio track the moment it lands, instead of a flat line.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open a screen recording that has sound, and press End to park the playhead at its end.
Open the Library, pick a second recording with sound on the Media shelf, and choose Add at Playhead.
Look at the Audio track under the new clip: its peaks are drawn, like the first clip's.
Drag another recording from the Finder onto the end of V1.
Drag a music file onto the timeline and check its bar shows its waveform too.

evaluate: Does the new clip's waveform appear fast enough that you never see a flat line?
Can you now aim a cut at a loud moment in the clip you just added?
Does the added clip's waveform look the same as the first clip's, at the same zoom?
rough: Only the missing redraw was fixed. How the waveform itself looks next to the video-audio mock (bar colour, height, peaks drawn as a filled shape) is unchanged by this task.
